services.name: gateway
services.summary: Localhost HTTP front for copilot -p with buffered and SSE streaming branches

services.name: telegram-bridge
services.summary: Telegram long-poll ingress; forwards messages to the gateway and streams replies back

services.name: scheduler
services.summary: Cron runner over runtime/jobs.json; executes copilot-prompt workflows on schedule

services.name: health-probe
services.summary: Two-tier liveness probe: cheap status checks every 30 min, real prompt round-trip every 6 h

services.name: web-browser
services.summary: Long-lived Playwright daemon on 127.0.0.1:8788; HTTP API for search/open/read driving the research skill

tools.name: web-fetcher
tools.summary: Playwright-based URL content extractor (tweets, YouTube transcripts, Readability articles)

tools.name: gh
tools.summary: GitHub CLI — issues, PRs, repos, releases, gists, workflows, arbitrary gh api calls

tools.name: node
tools.summary: Node.js runtime — used by all telegram-bridge services and web-fetcher

tools.name: jq
tools.summary: Streaming JSON processor — preferred over grep/sed for JSON

tools.name: git
tools.summary: Git CLI — local repo operations; for github.com round-trips prefer gh

tools.name: curl
tools.summary: HTTP client — use for raw API calls when no specialized CLI exists

tools.name: python3
tools.summary: Python 3 — quick scripts, date math, ad-hoc data wrangling

tools.name: rg
tools.summary: ripgrep — fast recursive code search; respects .gitignore; preferred over grep -r

tools.name: systemctl
tools.summary: Systemd user service control — for restarting kayo-bot after service/env changes

tools.name: copilot
tools.summary: GitHub Copilot CLI — the brain Kayo runs prompts through; invoked by gateway.js

tools.name: validate-registry
tools.summary: Pre-commit check for .github/registry.json — JSON parses, paths exist, skill files have frontmatter, every skill has a routing line. Exit 0 = clean, 1 = issues printed.
tools.installCmd: ships with the repo; run via `node scripts/validate-registry.js`
